The main takeaway from our work is that
molecular techniques are a useful tool in identifying mutations that cause resistance to RMP and INH.
the Inno-LiPAB assay is a useful method for detecting RMP resistance in M. tuberculosis, but it does not detect all of the mutations in the rpsB gene.
